extraction_method: Text was extracted from the hash-pinned NASA PDFs with pypdf 6.10.0; the LTP timeline page was also rendered and inspected at full resolution.

sources.document: Artemis II Lunar Science Data User Guide
sources.extract: information about a target's observation availability window
sources.interpretation: The guide defines the OTR start/end context as availability, not as named optical-contact boundaries.

sources.extract: A graphical schedule detailing target visibility windows and observation request times.
sources.interpretation: Visibility windows and request times are distinct timeline concepts.
The rendered timeline separately encodes a target's visible interval and its requested observation time.

sources.document: Artemis II Lunar Science Operations Report
sources.extract: start and end times, duration, prompts
sources.interpretation: The report lists OTR timing fields but does not define either endpoint as first or last optical contact.
The archived Earthrise availability interval is 4.147844 seconds long.
